outcome: composite neonatal outcome (neonatal death, neonatal intensive care unit admission, surfactant use, ventilation use, seizure)
severe maternal morbidity (maternal intensive care unit admission, transfusion, uterine rupture, hysterectomy)
cohort: The study included 11,174,890 nulliparous individuals with singleton pregnancies who delivered at 20 weeks or greater, using U.S. vital statistics data from 2011 to 2020.
finding: Incremental increases in prepregnancy BMI are linked to progressively higher risks of adverse neonatal and maternal outcomes.
followup_time: Neonatal period for babies and peripartum for mothers
